const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
  "http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:'https://www.v2ex.com/feed/sidehustle.json',headers:{Host:'www.v2ex.com','User-Agent':UA}},function(res){",
  "  const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "  res.on('end',function(){",
  "    let j;",
  "    try{ j=JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')); }catch(e){ console.log('ERR',e.message); return; }",
  "    const items=j.items||[];",
  "    console.log('JSON FEED ITEMS:', items.length);",
  "    for(const it of items){",
  "      const id=(it.url||'').split('/t/')[1]||'';",
  "      console.log('---');",
  "      console.log('ID:', id, '| DATE:', (it.date_published||'').substring(0,10));",
  "      console.log('TITLE:', it.title);",
  "      const body=(it.content_html||it.content_text||'').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim();",
  "      console.log('BODY:', body.substring(0,400));",
  "    }",
  "  });",
  "});",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-jf.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-jf.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Parse V2EX sidehustle JSON feed", timeoutMs: 200000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 12000));
